mechanism_narrative: FGFR4 (RTK) and OSMR (cytokine receptor) are co-expressed in aged MuSC (FGFR4 pc=0.45, OSMR pc=0.12). The flexible_GS4 linker (~20 Å) forces close proximity between FGFR4's kinase domain (aa 467-755) and OSMR's JAK-associated intracellular domain (aa 762-979). FGFR4's kinase transphosphorylates OSMR-associated JAK1/JAK2 docking sites, while OSMR-associated JAKs phosphorylate FGFR4's C-terminal tyrosines — creating hybrid phosphotyrosine motifs that recruit GRB2-SHC1-SOS (MAPK), FRS2-GAB1-PIK3R1 (PI3K/AKT), and STAT3/STAT5 (JAK-STAT) adaptors. PLCγ is sterically excluded because its large PH-PLC catalytic domains cannot bridge the asymmetric ECD geometry (FGFR4 ECD=348aa vs OSMR ECD=713aa, |Δ|=365aa) with a short ~20 Å linker. The biased output is MAPK+PI3K/AKT+STAT3/5 activation without PLCγ/Ca²⁺ signaling — a rejuvenating signature that upregulates muscle structural genes (ACTA2, MYL9, MYH11) and downregulates aged IEG markers (EGR1, FOS, JUN, IL32).
